behavior: Missing declared labels are created once, present ones (case-insensitive) left alone; a second run creates nothing
--dry-run lists the missing labels and creates none
No dependabot.yml, or no labels: no label call beyond the read
A failed gh label create is an error naming the label and repository
bitacora-rollout.sh runs dotf init github per repo, --dry-run under --check, not under --backfill-only, failure or [WARN] is an error
verification: bats tests/bitacora-rollout.bats --filter 'GitHub repo defaults|dotf init github'
